verdict.rationale: Dagster's automations are defined as code (asset/job definitions), which implicitly supports versioning and rollback via standard git workflows, and community evidence notes Dagster has figured out 'development branches' for review workflows; the changelog also shows automation condition evaluations exposing history-dependent state for review. However, there is no first-party documentation of a built-in version-history UI, diff/review workflow, or one-click rollback mechanism specific to automations. missing for 10: explicit built-in versioning/audit UI for automation definitions, a documented review/approval workflow, and a documented rollback mechanism beyond generic git revert.
